review:
Big Bass Halloween gives the fisherman a spooky makeover while keeping the series' core gameplay intact. The 5x3 grid has 10 paylines, with crows, hooks and blood-stained scatters joining the reels. Fish land with random cash values between 2x and 2,000x the bet, and the hook-wielding fisherman acts as the wild.

Three or more scatters award up to 20 free spins. Whenever the fisherman lands during the bonus, he collects the cash value of every fish on screen. Each fisherman is also counted, and every fourth one adds 10 more free spins while raising the multiplier applied to future fish collections. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win for this game on its page. It's a seasonal reskin rather than a reinvention, but the theme is well done.
